title: 企业信息查询服务配置
description: 已预填公共体验凭证，直接确定即可开始使用。体验额度为所有用户共享，用尽后请到 tokensd.com.cn 领取专属额度并把 apiKey 换成自己的。凭证仅保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录下，不经过云端。
description_en: A shared trial credential is pre-filled — just confirm to start. The trial quota is shared by all users; once exhausted, get your own at tokensd.com.cn and replace the apiKey here. Credentials are stored locally only.
docLabel: 领取专属免费额度与 apiKey

fields.label: apiKey
fields.description: 默认填的是公共体验凭证。在 tokensd.com.cn 用综金平台统一登录开通后，把这里换成自己的 apiKey，额度与用量才会单独计。
fields.description_en: Defaults to a shared trial credential. Replace it with your own apiKey after signing up at tokensd.com.cn.
